content:
LAREDO — A 27-year-old Laredo man was booked into the Webb County Jail on Friday on three state jail felony charges alleging he abandoned or endangered a child with intent to return, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Hiram Lee Robles was arrested on October 23, 2026, at 3:45 p.m. The booking record charges him with three counts of abandon or endanger child with intent to return — state jail felonies under Texas law. Bond had not been set on the charges as of booking.

The arrest was made by the Laredo Police Department, according to the Webb County public-access court records.

A state jail felony in Texas is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail and a fine of up to $10,000.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
